body:
From Lane A mobile audit of #264/#265. Cosmetic, no behavioral impact, tsc clean.

`src/api/coachExerciseApi.ts:122-130` — `classify(status)` is typed `: CommunityApiError['kind']` (includes `'contract'`) but only ever returns transport kinds; `'contract'` is thrown separately in the `schema.parse` catch (lines 164-170). The return annotation is wider than the function's actual range.

Fix (optional): narrow the return to the transport subset, or leave as-is (it mirrors `communityVoiceApi.classify`).

Origin: lane_a_mobile_audit.md finding 2.
title: [P3] coachExerciseApi classify() return type wider than its range (cosmetic)
